integrity: Complete proof and a standalone finite consistency checker are included. All asymptotic and unbounded statements rest on exact algebraic arguments, not finite trials. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only lengths (7^k+1)/2; no general classification of homometric sets or arbitrary very-odd lengths. Prior reciprocal-factor and count formulas are acknowledged. The full 1995 Inglis--Wiseman text could not be examined, leaving nonzero priority risk. The external independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact integer autocorrelations and sixth moments of seven-power very odd sequences
